static-black.$description: Static Black — Text, borders, icon strokes, button outlines — the structural ink that outlines every sticker-like surface and carries all body and heading type

paper-cream.$description: Paper Cream — Page canvas, body backgrounds, and soft section fills

card-white.$description: Card White — Elevated card surfaces and inverse text on dark panels

surface-graphite.$description: Surface Graphite — Dark card and panel fills for inverted sections

hardware-ink.$description: Hardware Ink — Near-black phone-frame and hardware fills (visually indistinguishable from #000000, used on device mockups)

hairline-smoke.$description: Hairline Smoke — Muted body text and secondary borders

placeholder-ash.$description: Placeholder Ash — Helper text, disabled-state type, and low-priority metadata

sticker-khaki.$description: Sticker Khaki — Card and panel fills — dusty olive-cream that reads as vintage paper against the white canvas

riot-pink.$description: Riot Pink — Saturated card fills, sticker backgrounds, hero callouts — the loudest voice in the accent set

voltage-cyan.$description: Voltage Cyan — Saturated card fills and feature panel backgrounds — secondary brand voice, often paired with phone mockup screenshots

toxic-lime.$description: Toxic Lime — Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

helvetica-now-display-cn-bold.$description: Display and headline voice — compressed, ultra-bold, negative tracking (-0.033em at 85–164px). Carries the page's identity: shouty statements like 164px section openers. Substitute with 'Helvetica Neue Condensed Bold' or 'Roboto Condensed 900'.

inter.$description: Body, UI, navigation, and small headings. Weight 400 for body, 500 for emphasis, 700 for subheadings. Letter-spacing -0.02em tightens the UI text. Free Google Font.

miss-fajardose.$description: Hand-lettered display accent — used sparingly (one observation) for a personal signature on a card. Substitute with 'Caveat Brush' or 'Permanent Marker' for the same marker-on-paper feel.

system-sans-serif.$description: Fallback body fallback; appears in 357 instances as the default rendering surface for generic UI chrome and inline text nodes.
